newsitem.title: UK: NWE Sept oil output up 3 pct at 5.87 mbpd - Woodmac.
newsitem.headline: NWE Sept oil output up 3 pct at 5.87 mbpd - Woodmac.

text.p: Offshore northwest European oil production in September rose by three percent, or 180,000 barrels per day (bpd), to 5.87 million bpd, consultants Wood MacKenzie said on Thursday.
With Norwegian production adding just 32,000 bpd to 3.2 million bpd in September due to a 10-day shutdown at the Heidrun platform, most of the extra came from British fields, Woodmac said.
Offshore British oil production totalled 2.41 million bpd in September, up 130,000 bpd from August. Britain also produced nearly 102,000 bpd onshore.
Danish oil output increased by two percent to reach a record 220,000 bpd in September, due to bigger flows from the Gorm and Svend fields.
Dutch production increased by around 5,000 bpd to average 37,000 bpd in September, Wood Mackenzie said.
